intent.purpose: slideshow hook frame in the saved budget-gym-at-night style, but a new scene
intent.scene_concept: full-body mirror selfie at the cable station of a no-frills 24-hour gym at night, a different spot and outfit from the source photo
intent.place_type: budget 24-hour franchise commercial gym (never a home or garage gym)
must_stay_true: same photographic style as digest S1: jagged, mixed fluorescent light, noisy shadows, cramped tilted framing
it is a commercial gym at night
it is a mirror selfie with the phone covering most of the face

appeal.relative_to_inspiration: at least as attractive as the person in the style source; the digest carries the photo's treatment, never her looks
appeal.face: pretty lower face with full natural lips (the rest is hidden by the phone)
appeal.physique: fit, curvy and toned: tight waist, toned legs, flat stomach with natural softness

subject.description: one woman taking a mirror selfie between sets
subject.action: holding the phone up to the mirror with her right hand, left hand resting on the cable-machine upright
subject.pose: weight on one leg, hip slightly out, shoulders relaxed
subject.face_visibility: phone covers the eyes and nose; mouth and chin visible

identity.skin: light olive skin with a sweat sheen, visible texture on the arms and shoulders
identity.hair: dark hair in a messy high bun with loose strands at the neck
identity.face: only the lower face is visible: natural lips, no makeup

physique.detail: full body in the mirror; toned stomach with natural softness, no stage-lean definition

items: charcoal bike shorts with a lint-flecked waistband
black over-ear headphones around the neck
wardrobe.fit_and_condition: shorts creased at the hips, socks slightly slouched

environment.setting: budget 24-hour gym at night, cable-station corner
foreground: mirror frame edge intruding at frame left
a D-handle attachment hanging from the cable at frame right
background: black rubber floor with glitter flecks and scuffs
grey textured tile wainscot under a cream wall band
dark exposed ceiling with ducting and bare fluorescent tubes
a spray bottle and paper-towel dispenser on a post
environment.clutter: busy: loose attachments on a hook rack, a stray plate leaning on a tower, a towel over a bench

camera.device: iPhone 12, rear main camera pointed at the mirror
camera.position: phone at face height, held toward the mirror
camera.depth_of_field: deep; the whole gym is sharp-ish and noisy

composition.framing: full body inside the mirror, cropped mirror edge at left
composition.crop: feet close to the bottom edge

small point lights over the equipment bay

lighting.exposure: hot speculars on chrome, noisy shadows

fingerprint smudges on the mirror glass

the left hand grips the upright with five fingers
two legs, feet pointing the same way as the shins

plates sit flat on the floor or on pins

no cinematic grade, film grain or vignette
no correctly readable text in the reflection

the exact spot, machine layout and staff member
